text:
maria-ops: FYI @kai-finance — Nora Corp invoice INV-7890 (due 2025-03-20) has multiple payment failures. Card declined 3x (last attempt 03/22 14:12 UTC). They tried ACH via Plaid but microdeposits didn't match. They asked for wire instructions and a one-time late-fee waiver. Need plan.

kai-finance: Do we still have tokenized card and how many auto retries ran?

maria-ops: Card token exists. System did 3 auto retries (policy = 3). We've paused further automatic retries.

stripe-bot: Payment retry attempts exhausted for customer:nora-corp (INV-7890). No further automatic retries scheduled.

ben-cs: On a call with their billing contact. They hit "account type mismatch" on Plaid. They will initiate an outgoing wire if we send instructions and waive late fee if sent within 48h.
kai-finance: Finance okay with one-time waiver contingent on legal sign-off and receipt of wire. Also okay to authorize a single manual card attempt if we get explicit written authorization from billing contact.
eve-legal: Legal ok in principle. Requirements: (1) signed PO or explicit authorization email from recognized billing contact, (2) copy of wire receipt once executed, (3) standard AML/KYC checks clear. We cannot bypass KYC.

maria-ops: I'll pause retries (done) and ask CS to collect PO + billing contact email. Ben, paste the wire details (redact if needed).

ben-cs: Provided (redacted):
```
Wire instructions
Bank: First Example Bank
Beneficiary: Nora Consulting LLC
Account: 000123456789 (last 4 = 6789)
Routing: 111000025
SWIFT: FEBEUS33
Reference: INV-7890
```

ben-cs: Customer also asked we attempt 1 manual CC charge after they email authorization — they think card may be fixed.
kai-finance: Manual CC attempt permitted only once and only after we receive timestamped authorization email that explicitly allows charging INV-7890 for $X. CC finance on that email for audit.
maria-ops: Action items: 1) Ben get PO + auth email. 2) Maria paused retries (done). 3) Kai prepare manual-charge approval template. 4) Eve standby for legal sign-off. SLA 48h.

ben-cs: Sending PO now (cc finance). Customer confirmed they'll include INV-7890 in wire reference.
kai-finance: Received PO, preparing approval template including required fields and authorization language.
eve-legal: PO received, quick review underway. If billing contact matches records, can sign off within the hour; will escalate on any KYC flags.
maria-ops: If legal clears: option A = one manual CC attempt with authorization; option B = accept wire and mark invoice PAID when funds clear + attach receipt. If manual CC fails, revert to wire.
kai-finance: Agreed. If manual succeeds, record method = CARD (manual). If wire, record method = WIRE and attach receipt; apply approved waiver.

stripe-bot: Manual payment attempts allowed only after explicit customer authorization recorded.

ben-cs: Customer confirmed they'll initiate wire if waiver approved and send receipt. Forwarding PO and billing contact email now.
eve-legal: Waiver approved pending receipt of wire; conditions noted (PO + wire receipt). If wire not received in 48h, resume normal collections.
maria-ops: Setting ticket priority high, SLA 48h. Will update thread when payment posts. :bank:
